syllabus_extract: Take-off and landing. Definition factors effecting take off distances. General performance, landing distance. Aircraft landing circuits.
specific_objectives: 6.1.3.1 Trainee will be able to describe flight performance of aircraft.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Activity: None. Safety: Nil. Supervision: Instructor observation.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of the wing during flight?
Define lift in the context of aircraft performance.
List two factors that affect aircraft drag.

topics: Definition of take-off and landing phases
Impact of weight and density altitude
development.content:
Definition of take-off and landing phases
Factors affecting take-off distance
Impact of weight and density altitude

General aircraft performance parameters
Calculation of landing distance
Runway requirements and safety margins

topics: Structure of standard aircraft landing circuits
Downwind leg and base leg procedures
development.content:
Structure of standard aircraft landing circuits
Downwind leg and base leg procedures
Final approach and touchdown techniques

summary_questions: How does increased aircraft weight specifically impact take-off distance?
Describe the key components of a standard traffic pattern for landing.
home_assignment_question: Research the definition of static stability and list its three main types to prepare for the next lesson on stability and control.
